signal_evidence.consumer_stress_tier: Notwithstanding the recent volatility in market and gas prices based on our data, consumers and small businesses remain resilient with consumer spend growth continuing above last year's pace.
signal_evidence.credit_quality_trend: Credit costs of $2.5 billion with net charge-offs of $2.3 billion and a net reserve build of $191 million; Card net charge-off rate continues to be approximately 3.4%.
signal_evidence.auto_credit_trend: Higher Card NII largely on higher revolving balances and higher operating lease income in Auto — no deterioration flagged; auto mentioned only as a revenue driver, not a credit stress source.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We have more bankers, innovation economy, more global banking, doing commercial banking overseas, opening countries, opening payment systems, opening branches — that is ultimately what deploys capital over time.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: The margin would be about what it is today, give or take, a couple of basis points up or down — holding but not expanding deposit pricing power in a competitive environment.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: Obviously, if you have stagflation, and higher rates for longer and credit spreads gap out, that will put a lot of stress and strain on leveraged companies...I think with the credit cycle it will be worse than people expect.
